posts.name: Oaktree
posts.cooked:
If anyone is curious here's the full LaCapitan deck and a few construction comments:

==== Ze Deck ====
Character: La Capitan

La Paradoja Magnifica
Temporal Thief (x2)
Maria Helena's Revenge (x2)
A Motley Crew (x2)
Walk the Plank
"All Together Now"
Final Breath
Trueshot
Battle Forged
Siege-Breaker
---
Gene-bound Guard (x2)
TCF Stalwart
TCF Conquerer
---
Suspicious Malfunction
Another Reality's Debt
"Explosion" in the Lab
Missing Resources
---
Fortune's Smile (x2)
Inconceivable Obstruction
Imminent Destruction
--------
Remarks:
1) "Theme" was giving La Capitan more ships.  And thus since there was "Walk the Plank" adding a card
with a shark in it just seemed to match.

2) Beyond (1) the goal was to get the deck some ability to steal and destroy cards, get more villain
cards into play, and get then be able to inflict some damage.  All without relying on the Baron Blade
and/or Omnitron cards that inflict serious damage and wipe a type of card.  The deck was still mainly La
Capitan since her crew cycling out repeatedly, if possible, is a good part of her theme and
effectiveness.
